Bug_Details: Scope annotations used as qualifier annotations don't have any effect. Move the scope annotation to the binding location or delete it.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using a scope annotation as a qualifier annotation and trying to instantiate it. The bug was fixed by moving the scope annotation to the binding location.
